node.title: EF component-control alignment
node.statement: The banked spi_component_control theorem applies to the extension-fiber alignment incidence used by ef_ru: after removing the base-descended section and restricting to relevant paid strata, there are at most polynomially many controlled-degree horizontal components to classify.
node.attack_surface: assembly of spi_component_control with the EF incidence notation
node.falsifier: an EF horizontal component not controlled by the Hankel slope-incidence component theorem
